objects.A_e: normal connection component after weighted pullback and shear
objects.C_E_t: lower-left block of R_e as a rational function of t
objects.endpoint_principal_column: residue in t of C_E_t at t=+1 or t=-1

typed_distinction: C_E_t and its endpoint residues are indicial/double-residue maps; they are not off-diagonal blocks of A_t dt.
prohibited_construction: Do not append a principal line to A_t using C_E_t and exponentiate the resulting rank-five matrix.
surviving_result: The rank-four A_t monodromies of Entry 793 remain identity. The principal-cell data belongs to the augmented indicial/Cech complex, whose differential must be totalized separately.
